items.title: Gooding Christie’s Retromobile New York auction achieves $51.5m with McQueen Ferrari leading
items.why: Ultra-high-end car and collectible sales show continued HNW appetite for trophy assets.

items.take: Ultra-high-end car and collectible sales show continued HNW appetite for trophy assets.
